primary.metric: M1 dead silence: among P_timeout+P_error trials where an admitted span closed as keep (uay>0), no assistant playback start within 6.0 s after that span's VAD end
primary.validity_guard: uay validity rate >= 0.6 in both arms and |difference| <= 0.15, otherwise no claim (harness/item problem)

side_effects.S1_scope: N1_resume, N2a_third_natural, N3_stop_fault, N4_echo_fault, N5_question_natural, N5_backchannel_natural, N5_wait_natural (treatment arm, all reps)
side_effects.S2_rule: pooled paired bad-outcome difference (T-C) 95% CI must include 0 and point estimate <= +0.02; no single negative scenario may have a CI lower bound > 0
side_effects.S2_jitter_rule: cross-arm signature disagreement on negatives must not exceed control within-arm rep disagreement by more than 0.05 (descriptive guard)
side_effects.S3_scope: test VAD end -> first answer playback on N5_question_natural, N1_resume, N5_wait_natural
side_effects.S4_rule: trials with speech_error/engine_error/page errors: treatment <= control
side_effects.S5_rule: N1_resume (user resumes 0.8/1.6 s after the cut, before the 2.0 s release): zero recovery playbacks

descriptive_not_gating: D_resume_late (resume at 3.0 s, after release): collision rate
N2b_third_fault: recovery rate conditional on interim admission of third-party speech
S_double_cut: on_max1 vs on_max2 recovery counts
exclusions: status != ok (harness error, budget_cut) are excluded and reported; a trial is retried at most once
decision: ship default-on only if M1 and every S-criterion pass; otherwise keep default off and report which criterion failed
